data.explanation: Review recommended: a plausible safety rationale exists (arms include carboplatin, cisplatin, paclitaxel, pemetrexed; the protocol mentions related safety considerations (p. 51)), but the precise threshold (≥10 g/dL) is not established by the available evidence; 3 comparable trial(s) used a more permissive threshold (precedent, not evidence of safety); 1 used the same threshold. (support score 1, challenge score 2)

nodes.label: Review recommended
Suggested action: justify in protocol

data.text: Start from the protocol's own safety rationale and treatment arms, and document why ≥10 g/dL was chosen. Comparable trials used 9.0 g/dL; that is precedent, not evidence that a lower value is safe for this regimen. This is a clinical review question, not a finding that the threshold is wrong.
